description: Ledger of `<file>.md §N` citations — inside canonical artifacts, and in the prose's own plain text — whose target section does not exist. Every entry is a normative obligation whose stated source has no home: that is a protocol gap, not a numbering slip, so it MUST NOT be repaired by editing the number. `artifact` is the citing file: a path under spec/v1/artifacts, or a zh/... prose page. check_artifact_prose_section_refs and check_prose_plain_text_section_refs both consult this ledger.
ratchet: This list may only shrink. A new entry is admissible only together with the spec report that owns the gap it records; landing that report MUST remove the entry rather than renumber the citation.

exemptions.reason: conformance-vectors.md never carried a §1.x level in any commit, and the obligation the row asserts — a production profile rejecting test DIDs, test key ids and test trust domains — appears exactly once in the whole repository: in that row itself. No page defines what counts as test material, no ak.profile.production.* exists to be the subject, and none of the 373 vectors in vector-registry.json covers it, although conformance-profiles.json grades the clause V and demands a vector_result. Renumbering would point a MUST with no content at a section that does not assert it.
